body:
Your rule (Decisions, Riding at the farm): a lesson first, then riding. 10 shared horses, nobody owns one, one rider per horse.
What will be built: a riding instructor in the farmers' people style. Riding helmet, boots, gilet, a whistle or crop. 3 versions for your pick in Model Compare (Farm animals topic).
Not built yet: the building chat makes it.

comments.text: Approved: same as Riding instructor (farm coach), you kept Ieva and Stan (31 Oct).

short: Merged into Riding instructor (Ieva and Stan)

title: Horse instructor (riding lessons)
